assumed.board_run_capacitance: case 2 adds 10/30/50 pF to SENSE or BUFFER (50 pF bounds a long run)
assumed.unpatched: read as no source on the jack (100 kOhm R_PD only); quiescent output and oscillation check
assumed.package: Neither TI model has package parasitics; SOIC-14 vs TSSOP-14 is not distinguished by any case

diagnostic_targets: overshoot <= 10 % and settle within 1 mV (sweep_precision.py) are diagnostic labels only, not acceptance

conditions.case1: PULSE -5..+5 V, 1 ms period, second cycle measured; 10 V-peak 20 kHz sine; source 1 kOhm or unpatched
conditions.case2: case-1 step, patched, with 10/30/50 pF on SENSE or on BUFFER
conditions.case3: follower driven by an ideal +/-5 V step, 499+499 ohm to jack; open/100k/10k loads; 0/100p/1n cable; metrics at jack and DRIVE
conditions.case4: jack PWL 0 -> +12 V (200 us) -> 0 -> -12 V (200 us) -> 0, source 1 kOhm
conditions.case5a: OPA4196 only; loop broken at IN- by AC voltage injection between SENSE and IN- (Middlebrook voltage loop); T = -V(SENSE)/V(IN-); DC bias MONITOR = I x 5.6 kOhm
conditions.case5b: OPA4196 only; 20 kHz sines and +/-A steps (100 us halves), A = 10 mV/100 mV/1 V/5 V; 0/7.2/15/30 pF on each of LED_A and LED_K
